closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, protein, and vitamin B12, but the biggest weaknesses are low potassium, low vitamin D, and quality swings a lot by cut and processing. It is good for muscles and strength sports, hormone health, and heart health because the protein section supports repair and maintenance, the fat section has enough useful fats for a support role, and omega 3 helps the fat-quality story without a big saturated-fat tradeoff.
